haikus.haiku:
Morning brew sighs soft
Steam curls like gentle lace bright
Savor notes bloom warm
Happy #InternationalCoffeeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Warm dough rises, sweet
Crackling oven, golden glow
Crunch of cookie bite
Happy #NationalHomemadeCookiesDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright noon sky smiles soft
Golden laughter warm fills air
Joyful toast rises
#HappyBirthdayWalterMatthau from @ClamBakeSanta
